claims.text: The proposed model performs similarly to baseline implementations while significantly reducing training time from six days to under 30 hours.
The model's ingredient attention mechanism allows for better handling of recipe retrieval tasks compared to baseline methods, which rely on more complex preprocessing.
Qualitative results indicate that the model achieves better cluster formation in the embedding space compared to baseline methods.
